spans.s:
Dyotana is, according to Sāyaṇa, the name of a prince in the Rigveda. This is probably correct, though the word may also be interpreted as denoting ‘glorification’ but it is not clear what relation existed between dyotana and the other persons mentioned in the same passage, vetasu, daśoṇi, tūtuji, and tugra.
Foot notes vi. 20, 8.
As by Griffith, Hymns of the Rigveda, 1, 380.
Cf. Oldenberg, Zeitschrift der Deutschen Morgenländischen Gesellschaft, 55, 328.
